messages.subject: Plant data and document list for the Crayford claim
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

As requested, here is our working list of the documents and data we hold for the claim - diary, weighbridge tickets, PLC logs, service and grease checklists, hire invoices, and the Crayford service reports. I've cross-referenced them so they tie to the bundle. Let me know what else you need for the expert.

The headline numbers haven't changed: best sustained ~210 t/h, 41 working days lost.

Karen Doust
Quarry & Plant Manager, Marldale Aggregates
